description: Passengers at Bahrain International Airport is a dataset listed in Bahrain open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a national body, published or maintained by Ministry of Transportation and Telecommunications / Civil Aviation Affairs. Movement at Bahrain International Airport includes passenger movement (arrivals, departures, and transit and Transfers) Departures: The total number of passengers departing from the Kingdom of Bahrain. Coverage: Bahrain. The portal files it under Transportation. Its keywords are Transportation, CAA. The portal shows 56 records. The portal flags it as a time series. The portal shows 2026-04-13 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support airport and airspace-related planning studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-www-data-gov-bh-portal.
